levels.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to Basic Move and a +1 bonus to Jumping (DX/Easy) skill for vertical or horizontal distance. You may make one extra attack at a -3 skill penalty if you also move at least 2 yards.

conditional.when: on Jumping rolls for vertical or horizontal distance

levels.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to Basic Move and a +2 bonus to Jumping (DX/Easy) skill. You may make one extra attack at a -2 skill penalty after moving at least 2 yards. You gain a +1 bonus to your Dodge score if you moved 3+ yards that turn.

conditional.when: if you moved 3+ yards that turn

levels.effect: You gain a +6 bonus to Basic Move and a +3 bonus to Jumping (DX/Easy) skill. You may make one extra attack at a -1 skill penalty after moving at least 2 yards. You gain a +2 bonus to your Dodge score if you moved 3+ yards that turn, and can make one "Force-assisted Pounce" per turn (see Force Jump/Leap, Expert level effect).

conditional.when: if you moved 3+ yards that turn

levels.effect: You gain a +8 bonus to Basic Move and a +4 bonus to Jumping (DX/Easy) skill. You may make two extra attacks at a -2 skill penalty after moving at least 2 yards. You gain a +3 bonus to your Dodge score if you moved 3+ yards that turn. You can also ignore 1 point of attack penalty from range or cover when making a melee attack after a significant leap.

conditional.when: if you moved 3+ yards that turn
